# Azure Cosmos DB

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/data/azcosmos@v1.5.0` · last audited 2026-10-20 (`658ecc434`)

### Known gaps

- Throughput: enforcement is a one-second token bucket per offer, not the service's partition-level RU allocation (no per-physical-partition split, no burst capacity); autoscale ceilings throttle at the maximum with no modeled scale-up lag, and its 10% floor is only reported as the minimum; serverless accounts are a single process-wide mode (--cosmosdb-serverless) with the 5000 RU/s container cap but no 50 GB storage limit; the replace between manual and autoscale is accepted on the data plane; minimum throughput is a flat 400 RU/s (not storage- or container-count-derived); Table API and metadata operations are not metered; the throughput error texts (min 400 manual / 1000 autoscale, steps of 100 / 1000, max 1,000,000) are from documented limits and the 429 text follows the task wording, not captured service responses
- IndexingPolicy: multi-key ORDER BY composite-index and excluded-path/scan enforcement exist (families.indexing); still open are ORDER BY on an excluded path, composite-index rules for filter plus ORDER BY, spatial/vector/full-text index validation, lazy mode, and enforcement inside stored-procedure queries
- MultiRegion: one fixed region (South Central US) with a single writable location; failover, multi-write, preferred regions, the conflicts feed and consistency levels other than a static session token are not modeled
- RequestCharge: an approximation of documented costs, not a metering of index and storage work
- Continuation: a query is re-executed for every page, so results can shift if the container changes between pages
- SQL: ORDER BY combined with GROUP BY is accepted although the real service may reject it (error text unverified, so behaviour left permissive); spatial functions are planar/haversine approximations with no Multi* geometry operations and no Geometry-mode (planar metre) semantics; ST_ISVALIDDETAILED reasons beyond the unclosed-ring text are paraphrased; unsupported functions are a 400 parse error
- ItemOperations: the change feed has no all-versions-and-deletes mode (deletes and TTL expiries never appear) and a single partition key range; pre/post triggers do not fire for PATCH or batch operations; stored procedure callbacks run synchronously and hold the backend write lock; there is no server-side bulk operation (the SDKs implement bulk client-side over batches and point operations)
- Containers: vectorEmbeddingPolicy, fullTextPolicy and geospatialConfig are stored and echoed only (no VectorDistance, full-text search or planar Geometry behaviour); computed properties are not used for index selection; the replace-time error text for a changed unique key policy is unverified
- TableAPI: $batch handles a single changeset of writes only (a batch holding a query/retrieve, several changesets or a 4MB+ payload is 400), and Table API responses carry no per-operation request charge or continuation beyond what pkgs/odatatable provides
